notes_for_editor: Thin record and a possible hold. The only source that names this tower is the tnlandforms.us Georgia list: position, county and elevation. Its entry has no Forestry Commission or register code, unlike many others on that list. The list does not state its elevation unit; 163 is read as feet because the record's 49.7 m equals 163 ft. Paragraphs 2 and 3 are statewide and register context, not facts about this tower. If you prefer the Copton approach, hold the story and keep the research file. Build date, status, staffing and access are all unknown. The Savannah article was read from its Wayback copy because savannahnow.com returns 403. Fact-check 2026-10-21: the NHLR and Former Fire Lookout Sites Georgia lists were read in full, and neither includes this tower. The story and summary now say the tnlandforms list gives no elevation unit; feet is a reading, not a source figure. Web searches used: 2.
